overall: The AG found the Select Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by letting three Planning Board members speak at its September 12, 2022 meeting, and declined to review the Planning Board's possible outside deliberation because the complaint was filed only with the Board.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board chair let a quorum of Planning Board members speak and deliberate during the Board's September 12, 2022 meeting on a warrant article.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, we find that Chair Weeden did not violate the Open Meeting Law by allowing three members of the Planning Board to speak at the September 12, 2022, meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged Planning Board members deliberated among a quorum outside a posted meeting; the complaint had been filed only with the Select Board.
allegations.key_passage: because the complaint at issue here was only filed with the Board.
